verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own MCP integration, with a help-center setup article, that connects a Puzzle account to Claude for conversational access to financial data. The evidence names only Claude as the client and gives no detail on exposed tools, read/write scope, authentication, or support for other agents, so story coverage is not complete. Missing for 10: documentation of MCP tools and capabilities (read vs. write actions), auth/setup details, support for agents beyond Claude, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation
